content: Iesu on Rome asi Wou Orot Gagamin an Agirotin Iyawasai
Iesu atonio osi bobo engon auris on sabu auris dura ikakafun isawar ato On inai au Capernaum.
Rome yangan asi wou an orot gagamin nan on an agirotin on inuaboai kwakwan, on orot on isawau ato kafakakai mom itarab.
Wou yangan asi orot gagamin on Iesu duran itatam ato on Jew yangan asi orot kawian iyafares sinai Iesu sifefeyanai itnat an agirotin itiyawasai mes.
Osi sinat Iesu aurin ato wawaninai bag sifefeyani siyau, “Atonio orot egogoi bag unibaisin.
Atonio orot on wai sabu inuabois kwakwan a on ekesin wat on wai bayoi goa iyon weinei.”

On mes Iesu on osi mat sinai. Iesu inat orot an goa aurin ibiufin ato Rome yangan asi wou orot gagamin on tuturan iyafares sinai sitawur mes, osi siyau, “Bada, Om men toum unisababanim mes. Yau men fofoniu on om unnat au goai unar,
mat yau men anonosin obiu on arimon fofonin tou atnat aurim atifefeyanim. Om asir dura wat unau mom, ato au agirotin on inyawas.

Yau tou mat on Rome asi wou yangan asi babadis gagamis osi asi baibad babanai abobo, ato wou yangan on yau babawui sebobo. Yau wou orot atonio on awur, ‘Enai! ato on enan; yau wou orot tani ba awur, ‘Enat!’ ato on enat; yau au agirotin awur, ‘Bobo atonio eiyamai ato on bobo ebiyamai.”

Iesu atonio dura itatam on iduduran, ato irutabir sabu kuayo On sibigibubunuai on auris iyau, “Awurem, Yau men meyan orot baitutumotin nanaba agaturai mes, Israel yangan amosi mat men nanaba agaturai on.”
Sabu dura bobibotis simatabir men sinai Rome yangan asi wou an orot gagamin an goai ato agirotin on nan sigaturai iyawas nono.
Iesu on Kena Jever Natun Fifi Orot on Rabob emon Ibobaimisirai
Men weromin gibunai Iesu inai au mafam gagamin wabin Nain on nan, On an baigibubunuotis a sabu kuayo gagamin on Iesu mat sinai.

Iesu inai mafam gagamin an furi awanai i’gat mom ato sabu nan on orot rabobin siyabar sibib si’gat. Orot rabobin min kena jever natun orot kaikas wat, ato sabu kuayo gagamin bag on mafam gagamin emon sinat on engon kena mat nan.
Bada on jever it mom on, nunuan iyababan kwakwan ato On kena jever aurin iyau, “Om men unatou mes!”
Namon Iesu ibib inai ato ire goru iruyein ato sabu orot rabobin siyabar si’nan on sitawar. Iesu iyau, “Jorei! Awurem, Emisir!”
Orot rabobin imisir ato ibosuruf dura ibikakafun ato Iesu orot ibo ayon itai men.
Sabu engon tutufin on siber kwakwan ato osi God sifain si’yau, “Aubairuruotin gagamin bag on sanati irobotet a God On inat an sabu iniyawasis mes!”
Atonio Iesu an dudur on irat kwakwan tafanam amonai engon ibonu a tafanam koun koun mat duran engon ibonu.
John Bapataito’otin An Dura Bobibotis Iyafares Sinai Iesu aurin
John an baigibubunuotis ato osi bobo engon tutufin auris on sikasonai isawar ato, on an baigibubunuotis ruam iyores sinat
ato iyafares sinai Bada aurin sitetemai mes, “Om aurim on John iyau, Om arimon enat o wei orot tani on wanmousin i?”
Osi sinat Iesu aurin ato siyau, “John Bapataito’otin iyafarei wanat Om wanitetemim mes, ‘Orot min Om aurim on John iyau, Om arimon enat o wei orot tani wanmousin i?’”
On an werai Iesu on sabu sawasawauis, fesafesaris sigaraba, a sabu ayu komasis tefasi simama engon tutufin iyawasis, a sabu matas fotis engon on matas siyeit men.

Iesu on John an dura bobibotis iyafotes iyau, “Omi wonmatabir men wonan John wonawur bobo aifan toum matamui woitai a dura wotatam on: Sabu matas fotis on matas siyeit men, sabu ass raguraguis on sebibib men, sabu usis gawugawudis on usis sigumidaris men, sabu tainas fotis on dura setatam men, sabu rabobis on rabob emon sibobaimisires siyawas men a Wasagobin on sabu ayuai sebikokoianis on auris sebibino.
On iyafan Yau auriu an not men ekuseseb, on aurin on yasisir gagamin bag!”

John an dura bobibotis sinai gibunai Iesu on ibosuruf John aurin on sabu kuayo gagamin auris ikakafun iyau: “Omi wogat wonai John aurin efan koiteterinai nan on, omi wononosin aifan wotitai mes i? Wayo ato yabat isisin sigegeris on woteit mes i?
Omi wogat wonai nan on aifan wotitai mes i? Orot beber obis wat imonag on wotitai mes i? Dura bag sabu ato osi sawar nanaba semomonag a sawar auris sebiaiwab on aiwab asi goai nan semama!
Wokasoneu, omi wogat wonai on wononosin aifan wotitai mes i? Aubairuruotin i? Yau awurem dura bag—omi on orot woitai on gagamin bag men aubairuruotin ba.
John min on aurin on dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, ‘God iyau; Yau arimon au dura bobibotin omi namui aniyafarai ami eta inbotitiwag weinem.”
Iesu an dura ibotein iyau, “Awurem, John on gagamin bag men iyafan tani nin emama ba. Baise iyai iyafan inikafakakaiai ato God an Baiaiwab amonai inrurur on arimon gagamin men John ba.”
Sabu engon tutufin a agim takes bo’otis on atonio dura sitatam ato osi min God an yawas totorin aurin on sifonabo ato John ibapataitois.
Baise Pharisee yangan a Baifafaro an baibebeotis on men sigogoi God an gogoi aifan osi auris on itafour, on mes osi men sigogoi John itibapataitois.
Iesu dura ibotein iyau, “Sabu ari semama auris on mamaba anifofon anau? Osi on mamaba?

Osi on fifirig gugudis ba baitotobon an efanai nan simairirin semama. Kuayo tani on kuayo tani aurin eyoyor yau, ‘Wei tabin an kwarer on omi aurim wakwarer, baise omi men woisau on! Wei rabob an kwarer on omi aurim wakwarer baise omi men wotou on!’
John Bapataito’otin inat, ato on bayu ikirir i’fofour a sareu wine men itotoman on ato omi wawur wau, ‘On dau tefanai emama!’
Orot Natun inat on bayu iyam itom ato omi wau, ‘Orot atonio woit! On bayu yam kwakwan a sareu wine etotoman kwakwan a On tuturan on agim takes bo’otis a sabu bokomasotis!’
Baise sabu engon tutufin God an gigiboan si’boai on osi siyoboet on dura bag.”
Iesu on Pharisee Orot Wabin Simon an Goai
Pharisee orot on Iesu ibebegai inat rus bayu sitam mes. Iesu inai an goai irui imair rus bayu sitam mes.

On mafam gagamin amonai on jever bokomasotin on an yawas tutufinai nanaba imama. On jever on Iesu duran itatam on Pharisee orot an goai nan bayu i’yam, on mes on fio yanden ninibin on kibub awan bonuin auman ibo inat
ato Iesu kounai itawar On ann bisinai nan itawar itotou ato maturun on sisusur Iesu ann sisusuruf. Namon jever toun tefanai nan Iesu ann isafanen, ann iyanen ato fio yanden ninibin ibo ann imuten.

Pharisee orot on Iesu ibebegai inat on bobo it mom, on toun wat aurin iyau, “Atonio orot on dura bag aubairuruotin mes on itsagob atonio jever on iyafan eruruyeinai; On arimon itsagob on jever on bokomasotin bag!”
Iesu orot aurin ikakafun iyau, “Simon, Yau agogoi dura tani anawurem.” On iyafotai iyau, “Basit, baibebeotim ekasoneu.”

Iesu dura ibosuruf ikakafun iyau, “Orot ruam sinai orot agim kaifarotin aurin sifefeyanai ato on agim ibo ites, orot tani aurin on agim 500.00 kina nanaba ibo ato orot tani aurin on agim orot ruam auyotoat nanaba ibo.

Osi rus on men fofonin arimon on orot agim kaifarotin aurin sitigaraminai men on, on mes agim kaifarotin osi orot ruam wabis isafanen. Ato orot menan on arimon orot agim kaifarotin ininuaboai kwakwan i?”
Simon iyafotai iyau, “Yau anonosin ato orot iyafan aurin agim gagamin bag i’boai on gagamin bag ininotburai.” Iesu iyau, “Om on dura bag wat uyafot.”

Namon Iesu on jever aurin irutabir ato simon aurin iyau, “Om jever atonio eit? Yau anat om am goai on om men sareu uteu auu asouen on, baise on jever on maturunai nan Yau auu isouen a on toun tefanai nan auu isafanen.
Om men ukakaiwiu rerebau uyan on, baise Yau anat nenei jever on Yau auu on nana iyayanin.
Om men olive momonai nan tefaui udebur on, baise on fio yanden ninibinai nan auu imuten.
Awurem,on an nuabo tutufin iyoboet on mes ebi dura bag on an bokomas sigaraba emon on sinotbur nono. Baise iyai iyafan kafakakai wat God ebinotburai on ebiyoboet on an nuabo on kafakakai wat.”
Namon Iesu on jever aurin iyau, “Om am bokomas ainotbur.”
Sabu fani nan kemai simair simama on sibosuruf tous amosi si’yau bonen, “On Orot on iyafan, On min sabu asi bokomas ebinotbur i?”
Baise Iesu on jever aurin iyau, “Om am baitutum emon uyawas; tufai enai.”
